channel.title: Research on Bitdefender AI Research
channel.description: Recent content in Research on Bitdefender AI Research

item.title: Deepfake detection
item.description: We develop multimodal (audio–video) and representation-level methods to detect synthetic and manipulated media, with emphasis on robustness, self-supervision, and dataset artifacts.

item.title: Generalization and mechanistic interpretability
item.description: We study how models generalize under distribution shift, how spurious cues and shortcuts emerge, and how mechanistic interpretability can diagnose and mitigate these failures — including graph learning, representation geometry, and debiasing.

item.title: Natural language processing
item.description: We work on large language models, code and low-level languages, multilingual systems, and structured domains such as molecules — with applications to reliability, reasoning, and scientific ML.

item.title: Reinforcement learning
item.description: We investigate reinforcement learning with a focus on sample efficiency and value-based deep RL.
